title: Isolate native qualification from persistent Windows credentials

criteria: SUSI_NO_REGISTRY_ENV presence is checked only in the child process environment before registry lookup, including previously cached credentials and snapshots.

Isolated keys, settings and home discovery never consult persistent Windows environment; synthetic child-process regression preserves normal user/machine and process/file behavior without reading real registry environment.
Native qualification, local workflow gates, local channel tests and startup gates explicitly set the switch on child commands after inherited settings are removed.
Disjoint gate_receipt.rs wiring belongs to its existing claimant; this change does not alter live production launch or user configuration.

verification: cargo test -p susi-harness --lib --offline --locked: 531 passed, including 21 secrets tests and the synthetic isolated child regression.
Targeted xtask launcher/source-contract checks: 6 relevant tests passed (channel, startup, integration gate, check environment, release proof environment, wiring contract).
cargo clippy -p susi-harness -p xtask --all-targets --features xtask/release-tooling --offline --locked -- -D warnings: passed.
cargo fmt --all --check and git diff --check: passed.

Tests used a private target/runtime/home and process SUSI_NO_REGISTRY_ENV=1. Existing native registry test created and removed only its unique synthetic HKCU Software test key; no actual Environment or credentials inspected.
Combined integration with native-link and receipt replay isolation is pending; no production deployment or qualification claimed.
